title: Ignite Playlist — Feature Onboarding KPIs & Phased Readiness Backlog
summary: Working spreadsheet used by Product Ops to track per-stage metrics, preflight gating items, and a prioritized backlog for small incremental feature rollouts. Intended to be a lean live artifact for coordination between product, SRE, and customer success; not the final launch plan. Focus: measurable gating, simple rollback criteria, minimal cost/regression risk.
metrics_table:
metric | goal | baseline (today) | threshold (block rollout) | owner | cadence
Daily 5xx errors (feature path) | <= 0.1% of requests | 0.18% | >0.5% sustained 30m | eng-sre | 5m
Request p95 latency (ms) | <350ms | 420ms | >550ms sustained 15m | infra | 5m
New-user opt-in rate (first 7 days) | >= 12% | 9.6% | <6% moving 3-day | product-growth | daily
Tokenized cost per 1k requests | < $2.40 | $2.78 | > $3.50 7-day trend | finance-ops | daily
Feature adoption (weekly DAU%) | >= 6% of baseline DAU | 3.8% | <2% for 2 weeks | product-ops | weekly
Automated eval pass rate (quality) | >= 95% | 93% | <90% | applied-ml | per-deploy
Escalated support tickets (feature) | <= 2 per 1k users/week | 4 | >6/week | customer-success | weekly
rollout_checklist: Stage 0 — Internal lab (0% traffic): confirm unit tests, integration smoke, perf microbenchmarks. Owners: eng, applied-ml. Exit criteria: eval pass >= 95%, no perf regression >10% vs baseline.

Stage 1 — Canary (<=0.1% traffic): enable feature for internal and opt-in pilot customers. Monitoring: SLO dashboards, error budget watcher alert at 15% burn. Exit criteria: 72h stable, p95 within threshold, no increase in escalations.

Stage 2 — Beta (1–5% traffic): expand to segmented customer cohort by geography and org size. Requirements: beta docs published, CS playbook, feature flag controls, cost cap set. Rollback triggers: token cost > threshold OR quality eval drop below gating threshold.

Stage 3 — Limited GA (5–25% traffic): gradual ramp obeying automated traffic gates. Must have: SLA doc drafted, legal quick-check complete, capacity reservation confirmed with Dedicated team if needed. Guardrails: auto-fallback to baseline model on anomaly; page SRE if >2x baseline 5xx.
Stage 4 — Full GA (>25% traffic): business signoff, billing updates, release notes, and permanent monitoring + alerting. Post-launch 2-week watch: daily ops review then weekly for 8 weeks.
contingency_plan: Primary fallbacks: 1) Feature flag kill to 0% (fastest path). 2) Auto-fallback to lightweight model variant with lower cost/latency but validated quality. 3) Geo-shift to backup region if capacity issues (requires infra ops). Escalation chain: on-call SRE -> infra lead -> product-ops -> head of product. Communication: incident channel #prod-launch, standardized customer update template in confluence:prodops/ignite-comms. Postmortem window: 72 hours draft, final within 10 business days.
decision_points: Continue from Stage 1->2 if 72h stable AND no more than 10% relative increase in cost compared to test baseline.
Pause ramp if customer support escalations spike > 3x baseline within a 48h window.
Require finance approval to exceed projected token spend by +15% before proceeding to Stage 3.
Require legal/data review signoff if feature touches PII or nonstandard logging.
